title: Console design system accessibility + wireframe grooming (Feb 2026)
content:
Purpose:
Quick capture of accessibility-focused findings from Feb design review, wireframe critique notes for upcoming rollout-config and model-selection surfaces, and a groomed backlog of design + engineering tasks to fix gaps in the component library. This is a working doc — notes are intentionally terse and include open questions for the Feb 25 design sync.

Summary / TL;DR:
- Major accessibility issues found in current wireframes: insufficient focus management in stacked modals, contrast failures on token cost chips, and missing accessible names on interactive table rows in the Request Inspector.
- Several components in the DS do not expose keyboard-only affordances (toggle groups, inline dropdown lists).
- Proposed immediate action: small design + engineering sprint (2 weeks) to patch high-impact issues (focus, labels, contrast), followed by a larger component refactor for the ToggleGroup and DataTable (4 sprints).

Key findings (screen-by-screen):
1) Model selection modal (multi-select):
   - Wireframe notes: compact grid of model cards with tags (LLM size, latency tier, quantization).
   - A11y issues: cards are clickable but do not have role="button" announced reliably; keyboard focus skips between card grid and underlying page content when modal stacked. Need to ensure modal trap and aria-modal true.
   - Visual: tag contrast (muted gray on white) fails WCAG AA on small text.
   - Interaction suggestion: convert cards to semantic buttons with aria-pressed for multi-select state; add visible focus ring per DS tokens (outline-3 + color-primary-600).

2) Rollout configuration page (canary + fallback):
   - Wireframe notes: split panel with traffic sliders, per-route pickers, and a live-preview of rollout impact.
   - A11y issues: slider handles do not expose aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax; keyboard increment/decrement not defined.
   - Data density: small numeric inputs near sliders are only icon-labeled — need text labels for screen readers.

3) Request inspector / traces table:
   - Wireframe notes: table with expandable rows (click to show token-level timing + KV cache hits).
   - A11y issues: rows are clickable but not tabbable; expand control is a chevron icon with no accessible label.
   - Performance note: long tables will need virtualized rendering; ensure virtualization preserves DOM order for screen readers or provide an accessible summary region.

Component library gaps (prioritized):
- ToggleGroup: lacks keyboard arrow navigation and proper aria-role group labeling (priority: high).
- DataTable: missing accessible row selection pattern and focus outline tokens (priority: high).
- Modal/Stacking: no central focus-trap utility for stacked modals; inconsistent aria-modal usage (priority: high).
- Slider: insufficient ARIA attributes + keyboard interactions (priority: medium).
- Tag/Chip: low-contrast states and small hit targets on mobile (priority: medium).

Concrete accessibility fixes (short-term sprint):
- Fix 1 (P0): Ensure modal focus trap utility + aria-modal true. Owner: Ethan. Dev ticket: PLAT-2345. Est: 3 dev days + 1 design day.
- Fix 2 (P0): Convert model cards to semantic buttons with aria-pressed and ensure focus outline token applied. Owner: Maya (design) + Owen (eng). GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/342. Est: 2 dev days.
- Fix 3 (P0): Add aria-labels to chevrons in DataTable and make rows keyboard tabbable; add summarized offscreen region for virtualization. Owner: Priya. Jira: UI-789. Est: 4 dev days.
- Fix 4 (P1): Re-audit chips/tags for contrast and increase token size where failing. Owner: Jules. Est: 1 design day + 2 dev days.

Longer-term component work (backlog):
- DS refactor: ToggleGroup v2 with keyboard arrow support, aria-checked semantics, and nicer visual states. (Epic: DS-66)
- DataTable accessibility overhaul: row-navigable pattern, expand/collapse accessible implementation, virtualization-accessibility contract. (Epic: DS-71)
- Design tokens audit: finalize focus token scale (outline-1..4) and map to color palette to ensure AA across components. (Follow-up: see design-tokens-audit doc)

Wireframe-specific notes (copyable into Figma frames):
- Model card: add an invisible label region that reads "Model: {name}, {size} parameters, {latency} ms, selected/unselected". Include aria-pressed for selected state.
- Rollout sliders: show numeric input next to slider with visible label "Traffic %"; keyboard steps of 1 with pageup/pagedown 10.
- Request inspector table: move expandable content into a region with role="region" aria-labelledby="row-123-heading" and ensure the chevron itself has aria-controls pointing at that region.

Open questions / tradeoffs for design sync:
- Stacked modal approach: do we prefer single global modal root (easier focus trap) or allow nested roots (simpler per-component)? Pros/cons to list in meeting.
- Visual prominence for focus ring: how aggressive do we want on default outlines vs. only on keyboard navigation? (Accessibility team prefers always-visible for testing.)
- Virtualization + SR: Do we render a short DOM snapshot of currently visible rows only (best perf) or maintain full DOM but with aria-hidden for offscreen (better a11y)?

Testing plan / acceptance criteria:
- Automated checks: axe-core run on modal, card, and table flows (must be 0 critical violations).
- Manual testing: keyboard-only walkthrough of three flows (model select -> rollout config -> request inspector) by two engineers + one PM.
- Visual regression: add contrast test to Percy for Tag/Chip states.

Backlog grooming output (tickets to create/update):
- Create: PLAT-2351 — modal focus-trap library, includes stacked modal doc and test harness. (Priority: P0)
- Update: UI-789 — DataTable a11y fixes (split into UI-789a rows tabbable, UI-789b expand aria-controls). (Priority: P0)
- Create: DS-66 — ToggleGroup v2 design + implementation. (Priority: P1)
- Create: DS-71 — DataTable accessibility epic (Priority: P1)

Risks / Dependencies:
- SRE: virtualized table changes may affect observability endpoints that rely on DOM hooks in the timeline tool — coordinate with SRE (ticket INF-402).
- Product: rollout preview wires depend on backend feature flagging API (backend epic BACKEND-508).
- Legal/Compliance: none immediate, but audit for color-blindness should be included in token audit.

Meeting notes (Feb 25 design sync):
- Attendees: Maya, Ethan, Priya, Owen, Jules, Chris (SRE).
- Decisions: modal focus trap first; toggle group v2 deferred to next cycle; slider keyboard semantics accepted.
- Action items: Ethan to open PLAT-2351; Owen to prototype card button in staging env; Maya to update Figma frames with aria-label text strings.

Next steps (week-by-week):
- Week 1: implement modal trap and card button change; small deploy to staging + run axe.
- Week 2: DataTable tabbable rows + chevron labels; create test plan and run manual keyboard walkthroughs.
- Week 3-6: backlog refactor work for ToggleGroup and DataTable epics.

Notes to self: keep this doc as single source of truth for the a11y fixes; add links to final Figma frames and record the manual walkthrough sessions (video) for audit.

References / links to build from:
- Confluence: Console Design System Index (see linked_artifacts)
- Existing PR: GH PR #342 (card -> button)
- Slack thread: #design-console a11y critique (linked_artifacts)

Unresolved / parking lot:
- Decision on focus ring prominence (defer to design leadership).
- Scope of virtualization accessibility contract (defer to SRE + infra).

End of doc.
